definitions.explanation: A bath with a thick layer of foam on the water, made by adding a foaming bath product.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泡風呂|あわぶろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大好|だいす}き→大好き：02911_daisuki⟧だ。
⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{泡風呂|あわぶろ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I took a bubble bath in the hotel room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入浴剤|にゅうよくざい}→入浴剤：20777_nyuuyokuzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦シャワー→シャワー：04503_shawaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てる→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{泡風呂|あわぶろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: If you add bath foam and run the shower into the water, you can easily make a bubble bath.
